answer: New identities anchor their earnings in a slow-release escrow: only 8% of accrued rewards unlocks each epoch, so a full harvest takes 13 epochs, while a 2,000 POA deposit stays locked alongside it. A farm of 500 clones would tie up 1,000,000 POA that long to collect 150,000 POA in drips, a loss no operator accepts when one honest agent earns the same drip from one deposit. A nebula of lookalike accounts could still hide behind a jetty of middlemen sharing one funding source, so each identity must hold its own deposit key, and any shared funding address freezes every linked escrow at once.
